description: [Procurement] Find out who wins US federal contracts and grants, or what a company has been awarded. Use for competitor research, partner finding or US public-sector sales leads. Price: $0.02 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/usaspending-awards

agency.description: Awarding top-tier agency name, e.g. 'Department of Defense'

days.description: Look-back days by action date (default 365, max 3650)

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.
